cards.card_text: So meet Noah, friend: a righteous man, blameless in his generation, who walked with God.
cards.verse_text: Noah was a righteous man, blameless in his generation; Noah walked with God.
cards.snippet: Noah was a righteous man, blameless in his generation; Noah walked with God.

cards.card_text: Walk before Me and be blameless.”
cards.verse_text: Walk before Me and be blameless.
cards.snippet: Walk before Me and be blameless.

cards.card_text: Then Moses puts it in one line: "You must be blameless before the LORD your God." Meanwhile, I can't stay blameless around an open bag of chocolate chips for FIVE MINUTES.
cards.verse_text: You must be blameless before the LORD your God.
cards.snippet: You must be blameless before the LORD your God.

cards.card_text: He will be blameless in doing it He will ask the LORD first He will wait until the harvest ends
cards.verse_text: Samson said to them, “This time I will be blameless in doing harm to the Philistines.”
cards.snippet: Samson said to them, “This time I will be blameless in doing harm to the Philistines.”

cards.card_text: He says he's been blameless before Him and kept himself from iniquity, so the LORD repaid him.
cards.verse_text: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.
cards.snippet: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.

cards.card_text: Blameless and upright Proud and stubborn Clever and cunning
cards.verse_text: And this man was blameless and upright, fearing God and shunning evil.
cards.snippet: And this man was blameless and upright, fearing God and shunning evil.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD asks Satan, "Have you considered My servant Job?" and says there's no one on earth like him, blameless and upright, a man who fears God and shuns evil.
cards.verse_text: For there is no one on earth like him, a man who is blameless and upright, who fears God and shuns evil.
cards.snippet: …there is no one on earth like him, a man who is blameless and upright, who fears God and shuns evil.

cards.card_text: Bildad says God does not ___ the blameless, nor will He strengthen the hand of evildoers.
cards.verse_text: Behold, God does not reject the blameless, nor will He strengthen the hand of evildoers.
cards.snippet: Behold, God does not reject the blameless, nor will He strengthen the hand of evildoers.

cards.card_text: Job says he is blameless.
cards.verse_text: Though I am blameless, I have no concern for myself; I despise my own life.
cards.snippet: Though I am blameless, I have no concern for myself; I despise my own life.

cards.card_text: Then Job says it's all the same: "He destroys both the blameless and the wicked." He even says that when sudden death comes, God mocks the despair of the innocent.
cards.verse_text: It is all the same, and so I say, ‘He destroys both the blameless and the wicked.’ When the scourge brings sudden death, He mocks the despair of the innocent.
cards.snippet: …is all the same, and so I say, ‘He destroys both the blameless and the wicked.’ When the scourge brings sudden death, He mocks the…

cards.card_text: Eliphaz asks Job, “Does it delight the Almighty that you are righteous?” Then he asks if God profits when Job's ways are blameless.
cards.verse_text: Does He profit if your ways are blameless?
cards.snippet: Does He profit if your ways are blameless?

cards.card_text: He says God's ordinances are before him, and he's been blameless and kept himself from iniquity.
cards.verse_text: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.
cards.snippet: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.

cards.card_text: Then David speaks to the LORD Himself: to the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless, and to the pure You show Yourself pure.
cards.verse_text: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless; to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.
cards.snippet: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless; to the pure You show Yourself pure, but…

cards.card_text: True or false: David says that when God keeps him from willful sins, he will be blameless and cleansed of great transgression.
cards.verse_text: Then I will be blameless and cleansed of great transgression.
cards.snippet: Then I will be blameless and cleansed of great transgression.

cards.card_text: David says the LORD knows the days of the blameless.
cards.verse_text: The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.
cards.snippet: The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.

cards.card_text: Now David says to consider the blameless and observe the upright.
cards.verse_text: Consider the blameless and observe the upright, for posterity awaits the man of peace.
cards.snippet: Consider the blameless and observe the upright, for posterity awaits the man of peace.

cards.card_text: True or false: David says to consider the blameless and observe the upright, because hardship awaits the man of peace.
cards.verse_text: Consider the blameless and observe the upright, for posterity awaits the man of peace.
cards.snippet: Consider the blameless and observe the upright, for posterity awaits the man of peace.

cards.card_text: True or false: David says God is blameless when He judges.
cards.verse_text: Against You, You only, have I sinned and done what is evil in Your sight, so that You may be proved right when You speak and blameless when You judge.
cards.snippet: …sight, so that You may be proved right when You speak and blameless when You judge.

cards.card_text: David says he'll ponder the way that is blameless.
cards.verse_text: I will ponder the way that is blameless—when will You come to me?
cards.snippet: I will ponder the way that is blameless—when will You come to me?

cards.card_text: He kicks it off with a big announcement: 'Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD.'
cards.verse_text: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD.
cards.snippet: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD.

cards.card_text: He asks that it be blameless in God's statutes.
cards.verse_text: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame.
cards.snippet: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame.

cards.card_text: Why does the psalmist want his heart to be blameless in God's statutes?
cards.verse_text: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame.
cards.snippet: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame.

cards.card_text: What happens to the upright and the blameless?
cards.verse_text: For the upright will inhabit the land, and the blameless will remain in it;
cards.snippet: For the upright will inhabit the land, and the blameless will remain in it;

cards.card_text: Solomon says the righteousness of the blameless directs their path.
cards.verse_text: The righteousness of the blameless directs their path, but the wicked fall by their own wickedness.
cards.snippet: The righteousness of the blameless directs their path, but the wicked fall by their own wickedness.

cards.card_text: The blameless in their walk The rich in their giving The strong in their youth
cards.verse_text: The perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but the blameless in their walk are His delight.
cards.snippet: The perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but the blameless in their walk are His delight.

cards.card_text: Someone leads the upright along the path of evil, while the blameless inherit what is good.
cards.verse_text: He who leads the upright along the path of evil will fall into his own pit, but the blameless will inherit what is good.
cards.snippet: …the path of evil will fall into his own pit, but the blameless will inherit what is good.

cards.card_text: Next up are men of bloodshed who hate a blameless man.
cards.verse_text: Men of bloodshed hate a blameless man, but the upright care for his life.
cards.snippet: Men of bloodshed hate a blameless man, but the upright care for his life.

cards.card_text: True or false: the proverb says the upright care for the blameless man's life.
cards.verse_text: Men of bloodshed hate a blameless man, but the upright care for his life.
cards.snippet: Men of bloodshed hate a blameless man, but the upright care for his life.

cards.card_text: He was blameless in his ways until wickedness was found in him, and friend, that one little word “until” just broke my heart.
cards.verse_text: From the day you were created you were blameless in your ways—until wickedness was found in you.
cards.snippet: From the day you were created you were blameless in your ways—until wickedness was found in you.

cards.card_text: Paul says the Corinthians will be sustained to the end so that they will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
cards.verse_text: He will sustain you to the end, so that you will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
cards.snippet: He will sustain you to the end, so that you will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

cards.card_text: Holy and blameless in His presence Rulers over every nation on earth Teachers of the law in every city
cards.verse_text: For He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world to be holy and blameless in His presence.
cards.snippet: …in Him before the foundation of the world to be holy and blameless in His presence.

cards.card_text: Paul prays the believers at Philippi grow in love so they can test and prove what is ___ and be pure and blameless for the day of Christ best popular easiest
cards.verse_text: so that you may be able to test and prove what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,
cards.snippet: …to test and prove what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,

cards.card_text: Paul says why: so they may be blameless and pure, children of God without fault in a crooked and perverse generation.
cards.verse_text: so that you may be blameless and pure, children of God without fault in a crooked and perverse generation, in which you shine as lights in the world
cards.snippet: so that you may be blameless and pure, children of God without fault in a crooked and perverse…

cards.card_text: True or false: Paul says the Colossians were reconciled to be presented holy, unblemished and blameless in His presence.
cards.verse_text: But now He has reconciled you by Christ’s physical body through death to present you holy, unblemished, and blameless in His presence—
cards.snippet: …by Christ’s physical body through death to present you holy, unblemished, and blameless in His presence—

cards.card_text: Paul says his team's conduct among the believers was holy, righteous and blameless.
cards.verse_text: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, righteous, and blameless our conduct was among you who believed.
cards.snippet: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, righteous, and blameless our conduct was among you who believed.

cards.card_text: The letter asks that only the brothers' souls be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
cards.verse_text: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
cards.snippet: …you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

cards.card_text: Paul starts with a big one: he must be blameless.
cards.verse_text: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and who are not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination.
cards.snippet: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and…

cards.card_text: True or false: Paul says an elder's home life doesn't matter, as long as he's blameless at church.
cards.verse_text: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and who are not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination.
cards.snippet: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and…

cards.card_text: Spotless and blameless Watchful and fasting Bold and outspoken
cards.verse_text: Therefore, beloved, as you anticipate these things, make every effort to be found at peace—spotless and blameless in His sight.
cards.snippet: …anticipate these things, make every effort to be found at peace—spotless and blameless in His sight.

cards.card_text: John adds one more thing: they are blameless.
cards.verse_text: And no lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless.
cards.snippet: And no lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless.
